name: pnmpp

name: cimg
input_api: cimg_library::CImg<unsigned char>::get_load_pnm(const char* filename); width(), height(), and pixel(x,y,0,channel)
scope: P3 dimensions and two decoded RGBA pixels when maxval shares the dimensions line
family_note: CImg 4.0.5 misreads the original valid P3 control whose maxval occupies a separate line; a second valid P3 control with dimensions and maxval on the same line is used, and the limitation is not generalized to all P3 layouts.

other_valid_control_result.meaning: Valid P3 layout with maxval on its own line was misread by CImg 4.0.5; this control is not counted as a passing format-aware result.
